g.text: Quantum Factoring & Qubit Resource Estimation Engine

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Input:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Cryptographic Asset A = ( Algo_Name, Algo_Type, Key_Bits b )

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Quantum Error-Correction Model: Gidney-Ekerå (2021) Surface Code (d = 27, p = 0.001)

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: CRQC Attack Runway Baseline: Reference Year = 2035, Classical Lifespan X_years

g.text: Output:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Quantum Risk Profile R = ( Q_logical, Q_physical, Effective_Security, Runway_Years, Vulnerability )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: if Algo_Type is 'RSA' then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Q_logical <- 2 * b + 2 // e.g., 4098 logical qubits for RSA-2048

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Q_physical <- Q_logical * 4880 // ~20 Million physical qubits with surface code

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Effective_Security <- 0 bits // Shor's Polynomial Time Factorization: O(b^3)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Runway_Years <- max( 3.0, round( 2035.0 - ( b / 400.0 ), 1 ) )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Vulnerability <- CRITICAL_SHOR_VULNERABLE ( Immediate Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later Threat )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: else if Algo_Type is 'ECC' or 'ECDSA' then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Q_logical <- 6 * b // ~1536 logical qubits for P-256 elliptic curves

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Q_physical <- Q_logical * 3500 // ~5.3 Million physical qubits

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Effective_Security <- 0 bits // Shor's Discrete Logarithm Algorithm

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Runway_Years <- max( 2.5, round( 2033.0 - ( b / 100.0 ), 1 ) )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Vulnerability <- CRITICAL_SHOR_VULNERABLE

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: else if Algo_Type is 'AES' or 'Symmetric' then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Q_logical <- 0; Q_physical <- 0 // Immune to Shor's Factorization

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Effective_Security <- b / 2 // Grover's Quadratic Speedup: O(sqrt(2^b))

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: if Effective_Security < 128 then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Vulnerability <- VULNERABLE_GROVER_64BIT ( AES-128 Non-Compliant; Upgrade to AES-256 )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: else

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16a34a

g.text: Vulnerability <- COMPLIANT_QUANTUM_RESISTANT ( AES-256 Retains 128-bit Post-Quantum Floor )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: end if

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: end if

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: R <- ( Q_logical, Q_physical, Effective_Security, Runway_Years, Vulnerability )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: return R
